text: The paper reports the best MedQA accuracy per system, with a second value in parentheses, of 0.65 (0.63) for Medprompt, 0.64 (0.61) for Society of Mind, 0.64 (0.60) for Ensemble Refinement, 0.60 (0.60) for ChatEval, 0.60 (0.60) for self-consistency, 0.60 (0.59) for single agent and 0.58 (0.57) for Multi-Persona.
